excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content:
This history component of the portal network is starting to be real:  http://glados.ethportal.net/content/

We've got the HEAD of the chain content being consistently pushed into the network, and we're moving towards backfilling the deep history.  I expect less than 1-2 months for us to have the full history available.
